================================================================================
MARKDOWN VALUE OCCURRENCE CHECK - INTERNAL DATA CONSISTENCY REPORT
================================================================================

SKILL APPLIED: value-occurrence-check (per .github/skills/value-occurrence-check/SKILL.md)

FINDING: The markdown source table has 4 critical internal consistency errors
where the same nuclear level energy appears multiple times with DIFFERENT
Jpi assignments.

================================================================================
DETAILED RESULTS
================================================================================

[ERROR 1] PARITY MISMATCH - Level E_i = 4908.7(3) keV
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Markdown Line 45:  Egamma=487.9(2) keV    Jpi_i = 29/2+ → 27/2+
  Markdown Line 105: Egamma=1213.8(3) keV   Jpi_i = 29/2- → 25/2-

  PROBLEM: The SAME level appears with contradictory parities
           • Line 45:  Jpi_i = 29/2+ (positive parity)
           • Line 105: Jpi_i = 29/2- (negative parity)
  
  IMPACT: A nuclear level cannot have both +/- parity. This is a fundamental
          error in the source publication data.


[ERROR 2] NOTATION MISMATCH - Level E_i = 5635.7(4) keV
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Markdown Line 32:  Egamma=306.9(2) keV    Jpi_i = (33/2) → 31/2+
  Markdown Line 87:  Egamma=899.3(2) keV    Jpi_i = 33/2+ → 29/2+

  PROBLEM: The SAME level appears with different Jpi forms
           • Line 32:  Jpi_i = (33/2)   [parenthetical: uncertain]
           • Line 87:  Jpi_i = 33/2+    [plain + sign: confirmed, positive parity]
  
  MISMATCH TYPES:
    (1) Certainty: One marked uncertain (parentheses), one marked confirmed
    (2) Parity: One missing parity designation, one has positive parity
  
  IMPACT: Contradictory Jpi definitions make it impossible to enter consistent
          data into ENSDF without resolving which form is authoritative.


[ERROR 3] NOTATION MISMATCH - Level E_i = 6300.2(3) keV
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Markdown Line 90:  Egamma=(947) keV        Jpi_i = (39/2+) → 35/2-
  Markdown Line 111: Egamma=1770.9(3) keV    Jpi_i = 39/2+ → 33/2-

  PROBLEM: The SAME level appears with different Jpi notation
           • Line 90:  Jpi_i = (39/2+)  [parenthetical: uncertain assignment]
           • Line 111: Jpi_i = 39/2+    [plain form: confirmed assignment]
  
  MISMATCH TYPE: Certainty conflict
    - Line 90 treats Jpi as uncertain (requires parentheses per ENSDF standard)
    - Line 111 treats Jpi as confirmed (no parentheses)
  
  IMPACT: Same Jpi value (39/2+) appears to be both uncertain and certain,
          depending on gamma ray context. This is logically inconsistent.


[ERROR 4] NOTATION MISMATCH - Level E_i = 6461.6(4) keV
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Markdown Line 13:  Egamma=161.4(3) keV    Jpi_i = (41/2+) → (39/2+)
  Markdown Line 99:  Egamma=1108.3(4) keV   Jpi_i = 41/2+ → 35/2-

  PROBLEM: The SAME level appears with different Jpi notation
           • Line 13:  Jpi_i = (41/2+)  [parenthetical: uncertain]
           • Line 99:  Jpi_i = 41/2+    [plain form: confirmed]
  
  MISMATCH TYPE: Certainty conflict (same as Error 3)
  
  IMPACT: Same as Error 3 - contradictory certainty designation makes data
          entry problematic.

================================================================================
ERROR CATEGORY SUMMARY
================================================================================

ERROR TYPE 1 - PARITY MISMATCH (1 instance):
  • Level 4908.7 keV has both 29/2+ and 29/2- designations
  • This is a fundamental physics contradiction
  • Severity: CRITICAL

ERROR TYPE 2 - NOTATION MISMATCH (3 instances):
  • Levels 5635.7, 6300.2, 6461.6 keV have parenthetical AND plain forms
  • Parentheses indicate uncertain Jpi per ENSDF convention
  • Same numeric value cannot be both uncertain and certain
  • Severity: HIGH

================================================================================
ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS
================================================================================

The markdown table source data (publication 2026BAAA) contains internal
inconsistencies that propagate through to the ENSDF file conversion. The
inconsistencies suggest:

1. POSSIBLE SOURCE 1: Transcription error when table was compiled
   - Different rows extracted from different experimental results
   - No cross-check for level consistency across gamma transitions

2. POSSIBLE SOURCE 2: Unresolved measurement ambiguity in publication
   - Authors may have measured the same level multiple ways
   - Different measurements may give slightly different Jpi assignments
   - Published table may include both preliminary and final results

3. POSSIBLE SOURCE 3: Multiple isotope/level confusion
   - Transcriber may have confused levels from different reactions
   - Unlikely given all data is labeled ^209Po

================================================================================
IMPACT ON ENSDF FILE
================================================================================

The ENSDF file (.ens) currently reflects these source inconsistencies by
containing MULTIPLE L-RECORDS for the same level energy with different Jpi:

  • Level 4908.7 keV: Exists with both 29/2+ and 29/2- in separate L-records
  • Level 5635.7 keV: Exists with both (33/2) and 33/2+ in separate L-records
  • Level 6300.2 keV: Exists with both (39/2+) and 39/2+ in separate L-records
  • Level 6461.6 keV: Exists with both (41/2+) and 41/2+ in separate L-records

This dual-representation is VALID when levels are genuinely uncertain, but
it masks an underlying source data problem that must be resolved.

================================================================================
RECOMMENDED ACTION
================================================================================

STEP 1: Consult Original Publication
  - Review 2026BAAA publication (authors, journal)
  - Determine authoritative Jpi for each level
  - Clarify: Is level 4908.7 keV definitely 29/2+ or 29/2-?
  - Clarify: Are levels 5635.7, 6300.2, 6461.6 keV uncertain or confirmed?

STEP 2: Correct Markdown Table
  - Update source table to show single, consistent Jpi per level
  - Add footnote if uncertainty must be noted
  - Ensure all gamma ray transitions reference corrected level properties

STEP 3: Synchronize ENSDF File
  - Remove duplicate L-records once source is clarified
  - Keep only one L-record per unique level energy with correct Jpi
  - Update associated G-records to reference correct L-record

STEP 4: Validation
  - Re-run value-occurrence check to confirm consistency
  - Perform spot-check against corrected markdown table
  - Verify ENSDF file structure integrity

================================================================================
CONCLUSION
================================================================================

The markdown source table for ^209Po has 4 internal data consistency errors
that MUST be resolved before finalizing ENSDF evaluation. These are not
ENSDF formatting errors - they are SOURCE DATA ERRORS that propagated from
the published experimental measurements.

The ENSDF-Agent previously reported these as "mismatches" between markdown
and ENSDF, but in fact, both files correctly reflect the ambiguity in the
SOURCE PUBLICATION. Resolution requires consulting the original authors or
publication to determine which Jpi assignments are authoritative.

STATUS: Value-occurrence check FAILED - Source data requires correction.
